_comment: Index Lifecycle Management policy for gym-tracker logs. Loaded by Filebeat
at startup (setup.ilm.policy_file) and enforced by Elasticsearch itself, so
retention does not depend on anything outside the cluster staying alive.
This answers the assignment's 'when are old logs deleted?'. An index is
rolled over once it reaches 1GB, 10,000,000 documents or 1 day of age —
whichever comes first — and is deleted 7 days after that rollover. Writes
always go to the newest index, so deleting an old one never interrupts
ingestion. Deleting by whole index is also far cheaper than deleting
individual documents, which in Lucene only marks them and reclaims nothing
7 days suits a course project. Production retention is a legal and
financial question, not a technical one: long enough to investigate an
